limitations: The completed artifact journey uses the deterministic mock provider and temporary local SQLite through a bounded worker/test drain. It does not claim real-model quality, deployed worker process composition, production database behavior, or a live social-platform integration.

The HTTP POST proves durable asynchronous intake only. The default API composition exposes discovery but returns 503 for POST until the existing manual admission service is injected; later delivery requirements own long-running process composition.

The browser gate uses the production Vite build with deterministic same-origin scenario and receipt fixtures plus the real local session endpoint. It proves the control surface and transport boundary, not live worker completion in the browser.

Source URLs are validated HTTPS provenance strings and are never fetched. The demo creates an inert LinkedIn draft artifact only; it does not publish, send, scrape, approve, perform an external write, or establish marketing outcomes.

Determinism covers normalized business payloads. Durable run, work, step, attempt, artifact, audit, correlation, and timestamp fields remain intentionally unique or clock-derived, and DEMO-02 through DEMO-06 remain separately owned.
